name: UI：任务管理-编辑弹窗任务名称验证
description: 验证编辑弹窗任务名称字段：必填/预填充/字符计数

steps.expression: (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)') || document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if(!modal) return { hasForm: false }; const input = modal.querySelector('input[placeholder*=任务名称]'); const label = modal.querySelector('label')?.textContent?.trim(); const charCount = modal.textContent.match(/\d+\s*\/\s*100/); return { hasForm: true, hasInput: !!input, inputValue: input?.value || '', charCount: charCount?.[0] || null, isRequired: input?.hasAttribute('required') || false }; })()

steps.description: 验证任务名称输入框存在

steps.expression: (() => { const cancel = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.trim() === '取 消'); if(cancel) cancel.click(); return 'cancelled'; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: F88预发已登录；存在任务管理数据
_testDesign.realDomNotes: 任务名称必填，最大100字符，显示X/100计数
